title: RYOBI ONE+ Cordless Stick Vacuum Kit
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B0DGN5KVZP identifies model PBLSV719K and UPC 033287218516, the kit with one 4Ah battery and charger.

comparisons.notes: Manufacturer-direct page identifies PBLSV719K and the kit with one 4Ah battery and charger; Add to Cart is available.

writeup: Woot has a new RYOBI ONE+ HP cordless stick vacuum kit for $99.99. This is model PBLSV719K, the kit that includes one 4Ah battery and a charger, and it matches ASIN B0DGN5KVZP and UPC 033287218516. Ryobi's own US product page lists the same kit in stock for $249 with Add to Cart available. That is about 59 percent below Ryobi and saves roughly $149. Woot showed 1+ left with a limit of one per customer.
